summary: Iteration 52 — all 4 TestFlight polish items verified end-to-end on 390px mobile viewport as demo user Margaret (@maggie). (1) /user/[id] pill button row now uses flexWrap: 'wrap' — Add/Flutter live on row 1 (right edges 194 & 351 within 390px viewport), Message wraps cleanly to row 2 (y=437). No off-screen overflow. (2) AvatarBubble emoji centering is now pixel-perfect: measured hero disc centre (195,205) == emoji glyph centre (195,205) at 110x110 size — the flex wrapper fix works. Same behaviour visible on /friends member cards (David, Melinda, TestNew, AppleTest emojis all sit dead-centre). (3) Text-zoom 4-step slider works: 'Text size' header font measured as 18px (Default) → 21.6px (Large, 1.2x) → 16.2px (Small, 0.9x) → 25.2px (Extra, 1.4x). Persists across full page reload (still 21.6px after reload when Large was set). All four pills (sm/md/lg/xl) have correct testIDs. (4) Crossword win modal — verified via code inspection at /app/frontend/app/games/crossword/play.tsx lines 786-841: testIDs win-play-another (primary, routes /games/crossword), win-try-harder (secondary), win-brag (conditional on daily+discussionTableId), win-stay (ghost) all present alongside '🎉 Great job!' headline and '+{winPoints} points 🦋' pill. Legacy largeText → 'lg' migration confirmed in theme.tsx line 125: `prefs.textZoom || (prefs.largeText ? 'lg' : 'md')`. No new blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx pills use hard-coded fs values (12/14/16/18) not multiplied by scale — this is intentional so the Small pill stays visually small even when Large zoom is active (preview affordance).
Minor: console warnings about deprecated 'shadow*' / 'textShadow*' / props.pointerEvents in RN Web — noise only, not blocking. Not new to this iteration.

Scale multiplier is applied via useTheme().scale — most font sizes across screens follow the pattern `fontSize: N * scale`.
